text:
Maria Gonzales: Heads up — sharing the Polylane routing initiative canvas. Need product/arch alignment on launch gates before next planning cycle.

Tim Wu: thanks. can you paste the lane defs? curious about tenancy isolation vs cost.

Maria Gonzales: sure — copying the high-level lane defs:
```
Polylane lanes:
- lane-A: Low-latency (hosted + dedicated), strict SLA (p95 <= 250ms)
- lane-B: Cost-optimized (quantized models), higher latency, aggressive batching
- lane-C: Private/VPC, data-residency + contractual isolation
```

Javi Ortiz: question — on overload, what's the fallback chain? lane-A -> lane-B? auto or opt-in by customer?

Chloe Park: propose auto-fallback to lane-B with a token cap and degraded QoS flag. Apps should see a 206 stream with a warning header so they can degrade gracefully. :thinking_face:

Tim Wu: Acme asked for region pin + canary routing. What are our launch criteria to promise that?

Maria Gonzales: draft launch criteria:
- end-to-end latency and stability validated in staging (p95 <= 250ms for lane-A)
- canary with ~10% traffic and rollback hooks
- documented runbook + SLO burn alerting
- billing delta and quota hooks communicated to customer

Devon Lee: risk note — KV-cache warmup when switching between quantized variants causes 200–400ms spikes. Need perf eval and possible pre-warm strategy.

Javi Ortiz: action items: arch to prototype fallback and pre-warm logic in staging by 2026-04-18; product to get Acme signoff on canary window; SRE to author runbook + alert thresholds. :white_check_mark:

Maria Gonzales: prioritization notes — lane-C (EU data residency) is Q4 must-have for a pipeline of deals; lane-B improvements (better quantization fallback) target Q3 roadmap. We'll surface tradeoffs in next planning doc.

ci-bot: build #prov-polylane-prototype succeeded — staging image: gcr.io/redwood/polylane:staging-20260401

ops-bot: scheduled runbook draft review on 2026-04-12 16:00 UTC — invites sent to #product and #eng-platform

Tim Wu: ok — I'll loop in sales for Acme handshake. Thanks all.
